script.code:
def execute(node_id, node_data, context):
    import hashlib
    import hmac
    import time
    from urllib.parse import urlencode

    ts = int(time.time())
    hexsign = hmac.new(
        b'XgwSnGZ1p',
        f'ts{ts}'.encode(),
        hashlib.sha256,
    ).hexdigest()
    context['ticket_query'] = urlencode({
        'key_id': 'ec02',
        'hexsign': hexsign,
        'context[ts]': ts,
        'csrf': '',
    })
